Memcoins: from a joke to a cryptocurrency trend 🚀
Memcoins started out as a joke, but now they are a real tool for making money and having fun in the crypto community. 🌕 When #Dogecoin came out in 2013, it was just a meme, but today it's one of the top 10 cryptocurrencies! 🤯 https://t.co/OLojW7vtAC

Shiba Inu and the second wave of memcoins 🐕
Shiba Inu emerged as an alternative to Dogecoin and quickly became iconic. 🐕 An example of how memcoins can survive "fleeting popularity" and create serious communities!
